blocks.text: Present Simple — umumiy, takrorlanadigan va doimiy

Present Simple (oddiy hozirgi zamon) shakllari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 5–7-darslar): I **work**, she **works**, I **don't work**, **Does** she **work**? Bu darsda asosiy savol — **qachon** ishlatiladi. Present Simple «hozir, shu soniyada» haqida emas, balki **umuman** bo'ladigan narsalar haqida gapiradi: faktlar, odatlar, doimiy holatlar. O'zbekchada unga hozirgi-kelasi zamon — «**-adi / -ydi**» to'g'ri keladi: She **works** in a bank — U bankda **ishlaydi**.

Ilmiy faktlar, tabiat qonunlari, texnika qanday ishlashi, mamlakatlar va xalqlar haqidagi umumiy gaplar — Present Simple. Bunday gaplar «bugun» yoki «hozir» bilan bog'lanmaydi: ular kecha ham, ertaga ham to'g'ri. O'zbekchada ham shunday: «Suv yuz darajada **qaynaydi**» deymiz, «qaynayapti» demaymiz — qaynayapti faqat hozir pechkada turgan choynak haqida.

items.text: Cotton **grows** well in a hot, dry climate.
items.translation: Paxta issiq va quruq iqlimda yaxshi **o'sadi**.

items.text: Most banks in the city **open** at nine and **close** at six.
items.translation: Shahardagi ko'pchilik banklar soat to'qqizda **ochilib**, oltida **yopiladi**.

items.text: A good night's sleep **helps** your brain to store new words.
items.translation: Yaxshi tungi uyqu miyaga yangi so'zlarni saqlab qolishga **yordam beradi**.

blocks.text: Takrorlanadigan harakat va odatlar uchun ham Present Simple. Bunday gaplarda ko'pincha **chastota ravishlari** (always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never) yoki **every day / twice a week / once a month** kabi iboralar bo'ladi. Savol — **How often ...?** («Qanchalik tez-tez ...?»). Ravishning o'rni muhim: oddiy fe'ldan **oldin**, lekin **be** dan **keyin**: She **often works** late. / She **is often** late. Batafsil — qizil kitob, 94-dars.

rows: We **usually eat** at home on weekdays.
My father **rarely takes** a day off.

items.text: How often **do** you **visit** your grandparents in the village?
Kate **goes** to the gym three times a week, usually after work.
items.translation: Keyt haftasiga uch marta, odatda ishdan keyin, sport zaliga **boradi**.

items.text: Our manager **is** rarely in the office on Fridays.

blocks.text: Doimiy holatlar: kim, qayerda, nima bilan

Uzoq muddatli, doimiy deb hisoblanadigan holat — qayerda yashash, qayerda ishlash, qayerdan kelib chiqish, kim nima bilan shug'ullanishi — Present Simple. Agar holat **vaqtinchalik** bo'lsa (this month, at the moment, until ...), Present Continuous kerak (→ 1-dars). Ikki zamonning farqi 3–4-darslarda batafsil ko'rib chiqiladi.
Aytish — bu bajarish: I promise, I suggest

Ba'zi fe'llarni aytishning o'zi harakatni bajaradi: «**I promise**» deganingizda siz aynan shu so'z bilan va'da berasiz, «**I apologise**» — kechirim so'raysiz. Bunday gaplarda faqat Present Simple ishlatiladi: **I promise** I'll call you — «I'm promising» emas. Xuddi shunday: **I suggest**, **I advise**, **I agree**, **I refuse**, **I insist**, **I apologise**, **I warn** you, **I bet**. O'zbekchada ham «va'da **beraman**», «taklif **qilaman**» deymiz — «va'da beryapman» demaymiz.

items.text: **I promise** I won't tell anyone about your new job.
items.translation: **Va'da beraman**, yangi ishing haqida hech kimga aytmayman.

items.text: **I suggest** we leave early to avoid the traffic.
items.translation: Tirbandlikka tushmaslik uchun erta chiqishni **taklif qilaman**.

items.text: **I apologise** for the mess — we're moving house this week.
items.translation: Tartibsizlik uchun **uzr so'rayman** — shu hafta uy ko'chyapmiz.

blocks.text: Savol va inkor: do / does ning nozik joylari

Shakl tanish, lekin B1 darajasida ham xato ko'p bo'ladigan joylar bor. 1) **does / doesn't** dan keyin fe'lga `-s` qo'shilmaydi: **Does** she **live** here? 2) So'z ma'nosini so'rash — **What does** this word **mean**? («What means ...?» emas). 3) Kelib chiqish — **Where do** you **come from?** = Where are you from? 4) Ega o'zi so'roq so'zi bo'lsa, do / does kerak emas: **Who lives** next door? — bu haqda batafsil → 49-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He work in a bank.» → He **works** in a bank. (`-s` tushib qoladi — o'zbekchada uchinchi shaxs uchun alohida qo'shimcha yo'q); «Does she works?» → **Does** she **work**?; «I am live in Tashkent.» → I **live** in Tashkent. (am kerak emas); «Always I drink tea.» → I **always drink** tea.; «I'm promising.» → **I promise.**; «What means this word?» → **What does** this word **mean**?

Present Simple ni tanlashdan oldin o'zingizdan so'rang: bu gap **faqat hozir** to'g'rimi yoki **umuman** to'g'rimi? Gapga «**odatda**», «**har doim**», «**umuman olganda**» so'zlarini qo'shib ko'ring — ma'no buzilmasa, Present Simple kerak.

Present Simple kelajak uchun ham ishlatiladi — jadval va dastur bo'yicha voqealar: The train **leaves** at 7.30 tomorrow. Bu haqda → 19-dars. «Besh yildan beri shu yerda yashayman» esa Present Simple emas: I**'ve lived** here for five years (→ 11-dars).

rows: She **goes** to the gym three times a week.

examples.title: General facts: how things work
examples.description: Ilmiy faktlar, tabiat va texnika qanday ishlashi, umumiy haqiqatlar — ular vaqtga bog'liq emas, shuning uchun Present Simple.

sentences.text: Water **freezes** at zero degrees, so the roads get icy in January.
sentences.translation: Suv nol darajada **muzlaydi**, shuning uchun yanvarda yo'llar muz bilan qoplanadi.

sentences.text: The Amu Darya **flows** into what is left of the Aral Sea.
sentences.translation: Amudaryo Orol dengizidan qolgan qismiga **quyiladi**.

sentences.text: Bees **produce** honey, but they also **help** many plants to grow.
sentences.translation: Asalarilar asal **beradi**, shuningdek ko'plab o'simliklarning o'sishiga **yordam beradi**.

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan, children **start** school at the age of six or seven.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda bolalar maktabga olti yoki yetti yoshda **boradi**.

sentences.text: A phone battery **loses** power much faster in very cold weather.
sentences.translation: Telefon batareyasi juda sovuq havoda ancha tez **quvvatsizlanadi**.

sentences.text: The human heart **beats** about a hundred thousand times a day.
sentences.translation: Inson yuragi kuniga taxminan yuz ming marta **uradi**.

sentences.text: Muslims **fast** from sunrise to sunset during the month of Ramadan.
sentences.translation: Musulmonlar Ramazon oyida tongdan quyosh botguncha **ro'za tutadi**.

sentences.text: Doctors say that regular exercise **reduces** the risk of heart disease.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, muntazam jismoniy mashq yurak kasalliklari xavfini **kamaytiradi**.

sentences.text: **Does** salt **dissolve** faster in hot water than in cold water?
sentences.translation: Tuz issiq suvda sovuq suvdagidan tezroq **eriydimi**?

sentences.text: Plastic **doesn't break down** easily, which is why it **pollutes** the oceans for centuries.
sentences.translation: Plastik oson **parchalanmaydi**, shuning uchun okeanlarni asrlar davomida **ifloslaydi**.

examples.title: Habits and routines: every day, once a week
examples.description: Takrorlanadigan harakatlar va kundalik tartib: every morning, on Fridays, twice a month kabi iboralar bilan.

sentences.text: Bekzod **gets up** at six every morning and **goes** for a run.
sentences.translation: Bekzod har kuni ertalab soat oltida **turib**, yugurishga **chiqadi**.

sentences.text: On Fridays our team **has** a short meeting to plan the next week.
sentences.translation: Juma kunlari jamoamiz kelasi haftani rejalashtirish uchun qisqa **yig'ilish o'tkazadi**.

sentences.text: My sister **calls** our parents in Samarkand twice a week.
sentences.translation: Opam Samarqanddagi ota-onamizga haftasiga ikki marta **qo'ng'iroq qiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **takes** the 7.40 train to Manchester every weekday.
sentences.translation: Sara ish kunlari soat 7:40 dagi poyezdda Manchesterga **boradi**.

sentences.text: Once a month, the whole family **gets together** at my grandmother's house.
sentences.translation: Oyda bir marta butun oila buvimnikida **yig'iladi**.

sentences.text: **I check** my emails before breakfast, which is probably a bad habit.
sentences.translation: Nonushtadan oldin pochtamni **tekshiraman** — bu, ehtimol, yomon odat.

sentences.text: Oliver **doesn't drive** to work because parking in the centre costs too much.
sentences.translation: Oliver ishga mashinada **bormaydi**, chunki markazda mashina qo'yish juda qimmat.

sentences.text: **Do** you **cook** every day, or **do** you usually **order** food?
sentences.translation: Har kuni ovqat **pishirasizmi** yoki odatda **buyurtma qilasizmi**?

sentences.text: Every summer Nilufar **spends** two weeks with her cousins in Khiva.
sentences.translation: Har yozda Nilufar Xivada xolavachchalari bilan ikki hafta **o'tkazadi**.

sentences.text: After lunch, most people in the office **drink** green tea and **chat** for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Tushlikdan keyin ofisdagilarning ko'pchiligi ko'k choy **ichib**, o'n daqiqa **gaplashadi**.

examples.title: How often? **always**, **hardly ever**, **never**
examples.description: Chastota ravishlari va How often ...? savoli. Ravish oddiy fe'ldan oldin, lekin be dan keyin turadi.

sentences.text: How often **do** you **go** to the dentist? — About once a year.
sentences.translation: Tish shifokoriga qanchalik tez-tez **borasiz**? — Yiliga bir marta chamasi.

sentences.text: Jasur **always forgets** his umbrella, even when the forecast says rain.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotida yomg'ir deyilgan bo'lsa ham, Jasur doim soyabonini **unutadi**.

sentences.text: My boss **is** usually in a good mood after the weekend.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im dam olish kunlaridan keyin odatda yaxshi kayfiyatda **bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We **hardly ever eat** out because the restaurants near us are expensive.
sentences.translation: Biz tashqarida deyarli hech qachon **ovqatlanmaymiz**, chunki yaqinimizdagi restoranlar qimmat.

sentences.text: Emma **rarely watches** TV — she prefers podcasts and books.
sentences.translation: Emma televizorni kamdan-kam **ko'radi** — u podkast va kitoblarni afzal biladi.

sentences.text: Trains to Oxford **are** often **late** on Monday mornings.
sentences.translation: Oksfordga boradigan poyezdlar dushanba kunlari ertalab ko'pincha **kechikadi**.

sentences.text: Madina **never skips** breakfast, however busy she is.
sentences.translation: Qanchalik band bo'lmasin, Madina hech qachon **nonushtasiz qolmaydi**.

sentences.text: **Do** you ever **work** at weekends? — Sometimes, when we have a deadline.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari ham **ishlaysizmi**? — Ba'zan, topshirish muddati yaqinlashganda.

sentences.text: My grandfather **sometimes tells** us stories about his years in the army.
sentences.translation: Bobom ba'zan bizga armiyadagi yillari haqida hikoyalar **aytib beradi**.

sentences.text: James **is** never on time, so we usually tell him to come half an hour early.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hech qachon o'z vaqtida **kelmaydi**, shuning uchun odatda unga yarim soat erta kelishini aytamiz.

examples.title: Permanent situations: **live**, **work**, **come from**
examples.description: Doimiy holatlar: qayerda yashash, ishlash, kim nima bilan shug'ullanishi, nimasi borligi. Holat vaqtinchalik bo'lsa — Continuous (→ 1-dars).

sentences.text: Aziz **works** as an engineer for a big energy company in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz Toshkentdagi katta energetika kompaniyasida muhandis bo'lib **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Where **do** your parents **live**? — In a small village near Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz qayerda **yashaydi**? — Farg'ona yaqinidagi kichik qishloqda.

sentences.text: Kate **comes** from Edinburgh, but her Scottish accent **isn't** very strong.
sentences.translation: Keyt asli **Edinburglik**, lekin shotlandcha talaffuzi unchalik **sezilmaydi**.

sentences.text: My uncle **owns** a small hotel in the old part of Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Amakimning Buxoroning eski qismida kichik mehmonxonasi **bor**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **teaches** maths at a secondary school and also **gives** private lessons.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'rta maktabda matematikadan **dars beradi**, shuningdek xususiy darslar ham **o'tadi**.

sentences.text: The museum **has** over three thousand items from the Silk Road period.
sentences.translation: Muzeyda Buyuk Ipak yo'li davriga oid uch mingdan ortiq buyum **bor**.

sentences.text: Tom **speaks** fluent Spanish because his mother is from Madrid.
sentences.translation: Tom ispan tilida ravon **gapiradi**, chunki onasi Madriddan.

sentences.text: What **does** your brother **do**? — He **designs** websites for small businesses.
sentences.translation: Akangiz nima **ish qiladi**? — Kichik bizneslar uchun veb-saytlar **yaratadi**.

sentences.text: Our company **doesn't employ** anyone under the age of eighteen.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamiz o'n sakkiz yoshga to'lmaganlarni ishga **olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Most of my friends **live** in rented flats because buying a home **costs** a fortune.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi ijaradagi kvartiralarda **yashaydi**, chunki uy sotib olish juda **qimmatga tushadi**.

examples.title: Negatives and questions: **doesn't**, **Does** ...?
examples.description: Inkor va so'roqda do / does; does dan keyin fe'l `-s` siz. What does ... mean?, How do you spell ...? kabi foydali savollar.

sentences.text: My laptop **doesn't connect** to the office Wi-Fi, so I use my phone.
sentences.translation: Noutbukim ofis Wi-Fi'iga **ulanmaydi**, shuning uchun telefonimdan foydalanaman.

sentences.text: What **does** the word deadline **mean**? — The last day to finish a task.
sentences.translation: Deadline so'zi nimani **anglatadi**? — Topshiriqni tugatish kerak bo'lgan oxirgi kun.

sentences.text: How **do** you **spell** your surname? I need it for the booking.
sentences.translation: Familiyangiz qanday **yoziladi**? Bron qilish uchun kerak.

sentences.text: Nilufar **doesn't eat** meat, so we always choose a vegetarian café.
sentences.translation: Nilufar go'sht **yemaydi**, shuning uchun doim vegetarian kafeni tanlaymiz.

sentences.text: **Does** this bus **stop** near the central library?
sentences.translation: Bu avtobus markaziy kutubxona yaqinida **to'xtaydimi**?

sentences.text: Which bank **do** you **use**, and **do** they **charge** for transfers?
sentences.translation: Qaysi bankdan **foydalanasiz**, ular o'tkazmalar uchun **haq oladimi**?

sentences.text: Why **doesn't** Oliver ever **answer** his phone in the evenings?
sentences.translation: Nega Oliver kechqurunlari telefonini hech **ko'tarmaydi**?

sentences.text: James **doesn't understand** why his flatmate never **pays** the bills on time.
sentences.translation: Jeyms xonadoshi nega kommunal to'lovlarni hech qachon o'z vaqtida **to'lamasligini tushunmaydi**.

sentences.text: How much **does** a monthly metro pass **cost** in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Toshkentda metro uchun oylik yo'l kartasi qancha **turadi**?

sentences.text: **Do** you **know** anyone who **repairs** old watches? — Yes, a man near the bazaar **does**.
sentences.translation: Eski soatlarni **tuzatadigan** birortasini **bilasizmi**? — Ha, bozor yaqinidagi bir kishi **tuzatadi**.

examples.title: Saying is doing: **I promise**, **I suggest**
examples.description: Aytishning o'zi harakat bo'lgan fe'llar: promise, suggest, apologise, advise, agree, refuse, insist, warn, bet. Ular faqat Present Simple da keladi.

sentences.text: Don't worry — **I promise** I'll send you the photos as soon as I get home.
sentences.translation: Xavotir olma — uyga yetib borishim bilan rasmlarni yuborishga **va'da beraman**.

sentences.text: Since everyone is tired, **I suggest** we finish the meeting early.
sentences.translation: Hamma charchagani uchun yig'ilishni erta tugatishni **taklif qilaman**.

sentences.text: We **apologise** for the delay and thank you for your patience.
sentences.translation: Kechikish uchun **uzr so'raymiz** va sabringiz uchun rahmat.

sentences.text: Before you sign anything, **I advise** you to read the contract carefully.
sentences.translation: Biror narsaga imzo chekishdan oldin shartnomani diqqat bilan o'qib chiqishingizni **maslahat beraman**.

sentences.text: **I agree** with Madina: the price is far too high for such an old car.
sentences.translation: Madina bilan **roziman**: bunday eski mashina uchun narx juda baland.

sentences.text: No, really, **I insist** — dinner is on me tonight.
sentences.translation: Yo'q, rostdan, **e'tiroz qabul qilmayman** — bugungi kechki ovqat mening hisobimdan.

sentences.text: **I warn** you, the road to Chimgan gets very narrow after the bridge.
sentences.translation: Sizni **ogohlantiraman**, Chimyonga boradigan yo'l ko'prikdan keyin juda torayib ketadi.

sentences.text: Tom will be late again, **I bet** — he always is.
sentences.translation: **Garov o'ynashim mumkin**, Tom yana kechikadi — u doim shunday.

sentences.text: **I refuse** to pay for a meal that we didn't even order!
sentences.translation: Biz buyurtma ham bermagan ovqat uchun pul **to'lashdan bosh tortaman**!

sentences.text: Passengers, we **remind** you that smoking is not allowed anywhere on the train.
sentences.translation: Hurmatli yo'lovchilar, poyezdning hech bir joyida chekish mumkin emasligini **eslatib o'tamiz**.

examples.title: Dialogue: getting to know a new colleague
examples.description: Yangi hamkasb bilan tanishuv: kim qayerda yashaydi, ishga qanday keladi, bo'sh vaqtida nima qiladi — Present Simple savollar va javoblar.

sentences.text: — So, Emma, where **do** you **live**? Somewhere near the office?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Emma, qayerda **yashaysiz**? Ofisga yaqinroqdami?

sentences.text: — Not really. I **live** in a suburb, so I **commute** by train.
sentences.translation: — Unchalik emas. Shahar chetida **yashayman**, shuning uchun ishga poyezdda **qatnayman**.

sentences.text: — How long **does** the journey **take** every morning?
sentences.translation: — Har kuni ertalab yo'l qancha vaqt **oladi**?

sentences.text: — About forty minutes, but I **read** or **listen** to podcasts on the way.
sentences.translation: — Qirq daqiqacha, lekin yo'lda kitob **o'qiyman** yoki podkast **tinglayman**.

sentences.text: — That's not bad. What **do** you usually **do** at the weekends?
sentences.translation: — Yomon emas-ku. Dam olish kunlari odatda nima **qilasiz**?

sentences.text: — I **play** volleyball with some friends, and on Sundays I **visit** my mum.
sentences.translation: — Do'stlarim bilan voleybol **o'ynayman**, yakshanbalari esa onamnikiga **boraman**.

sentences.text: — **Does** your mum **live** far away from you?
sentences.translation: — Onangiz sizdan uzoqda **yashaydimi**?

sentences.text: — No, she **lives** just two stops from me. What about you, Aziz?
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, u mendan bor-yo'g'i ikki bekat narida **yashaydi**. O'zingiz-chi, Aziz?

sentences.text: — I **don't have** much free time — I **study** for my master's in the evenings.
sentences.translation: — Bo'sh vaqtim uncha **ko'p emas** — kechqurunlari magistraturada **o'qiyman**.

sentences.text: — Wow, I really **admire** people who **work** and **study** at the same time!
sentences.translation: — Voy, bir vaqtning o'zida ham **ishlaydigan**, ham **o'qiydigan** odamlarga **havasim keladi**!

examples.title: Mixed: facts, habits and promises
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: fakt, odat, doimiy holat, savol va «aytish — bajarish» fe'llari murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The library **lends** e-books for free, but most students still **prefer** paper copies.
sentences.translation: Kutubxona elektron kitoblarni bepul **beradi**, lekin talabalarning ko'pchiligi hali ham qog'oz nusxani **afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Whenever Aziz **travels** abroad, he **buys** a local SIM card at the airport.
sentences.translation: Aziz qachon chet elga **borsa**, aeroportning o'zida mahalliy SIM-karta **sotib oladi**.

sentences.text: In Britain, people **drive** on the left, which **confuses** many visitors at first.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada mashinalar chap tomondan **yuradi**, bu esa avvaliga ko'plab mehmonlarni **chalg'itadi**.

sentences.text: How often **does** the company **check** its computers for viruses?
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kompyuterlarini viruslarga qanchalik tez-tez **tekshiradi**?

sentences.text: Sarah **works** for a charity that **helps** refugees find jobs in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Sara Manchesterda qochqinlarga ish topishda **yordam beradigan** xayriya tashkilotida **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: **I promise** to pay you back on Monday, when I **get** my salary.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni maoshimni **olganimda** qarzimni qaytarishga **va'da beraman**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **don't speak** English, so we **communicate** with gestures and smiles.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz inglizcha **gapirmaydi**, shuning uchun imo-ishora va tabassum bilan **muloqot qilamiz**.

sentences.text: Why **do** so many young people **leave** small towns and **move** to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Nega shuncha ko'p yoshlar kichik shaharchalarni **tashlab**, Toshkentga **ko'chib ketadi**?

sentences.text: News **travels** fast in our village: everybody **knows** everybody else's business.
sentences.translation: Qishlog'imizda yangiliklar tez **tarqaladi**: hamma hammaning ishini **biladi**.

sentences.text: **I suggest** you book early, because hotels in Samarkand **fill up** quickly in spring.
sentences.translation: Erta bron qilishingizni **taklif qilaman**, chunki bahorda Samarqanddagi mehmonxonalar tez **to'lib qoladi**.
